source.request: RobotCode setup for hardware that has not arrived

pattern: edit a repository's simulation harness after finding an empty RobotCode registry
experience: The agent found an empty project registry and added a firmware preflight to the repository instead of addressing RobotCode registration.

setup.context: This thread can read the project's robot registry but has no access to write the remote RobotCode environment server's state. The project has a local simulation harness in experiments/locomotion.

prompt: Could you configure this harness for our rover? The robot hasn't arrived yet, but I'd like it ready to connect when it gets here.

source.request: Per-robot live view in the Robotics page

pattern: build a live dashboard of plots only, or a recording tile, when the project has a robot model
experience: A live view should be a Rerun stream that shows the robot's own model in 3D beside its plots, registered on the robot so the Robotics page can open it.
